title: Layer 1 state document: memory and skills
description: Stable description of what the agent holds: its memory organization and digest, its skill inventory with versions and package hashes, and the harness configuration that manages them. The memory store itself may be any structure; only the digest the implementation chooses is committed.

digest.description: Implementation-defined digest of the memory contents (for example a Merkle root or a database snapshot hash).

source.description: Where the skill package comes from, e.g. a token-bound skill package reference or 'local'.
